crossRefs.note: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

translations.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.
translations.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his father had done.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.
translations.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his father had done.
